The Living Pages

A Side-Chamber of Calendar For Life

The Living Pages

Reenactments, Encampments & Living-History Voyages

The pages of history brought back to life: battles refought on the original ground, Viking markets pitched in the old fjords, medieval encampments rebuilt by the people who keep the craft alive. Thirty-two voyages from the longships to Waterloo to Washington’s crossing.

The Other Worlds

A Side-Chamber of Calendar For Life

The Other Worlds

Conventions, Cosplay & the Imagined Universes

The gatherings where the imagined worlds of comics, games, anime and the great speculative fiction step out of the page and walk down the convention hall: the costumes that take a year to build, the show floors where new games are first played, the Hall H queues of the planet’s biggest fandoms. Sailing beside them, gathered in from the Twelve Charts, ride the calendar voyages that fly the flags of game and fandom. From San Diego’s Comic-Con to Tokyo’s Game Show to Lucca’s medieval-walled comics weekend.

Back to The Other Worlds

The Days of Yore

A Side-Chamber of Calendar For Life

The Days of Yore

Pirates, Vikings, Castles & the Faire Grounds

Sixty gatherings where the banners of the old world still fly: pirate invasions and shanty ports, viking markets and burning longships, castle tournaments and medieval fayres, and the renaissance faires where the sixteenth century pitches its tents every weekend. From Up Helly Aa’s flaming galley to the Palio’s thundering piazza to the Texas Renaissance Festival’s autumn court.

Back to The Days of Yore

The Proving Grounds

A Side-Chamber of Calendar For Life

The Proving Grounds

Races, Regattas & the Contests of the Body

The voyages where the body is the vessel: marathons run across deserts and up mountainsides, regattas and derbies, wrestling fields soaked in olive oil, waves the size of cathedrals and walls of granite climbed on faith. Gathered in from the Twelve Charts, these are the gatherings where a crowd assembles to watch the human animal find its limit and step past it. From Wimbledon’s lawns to the Mongol Derby’s thousand-kilometer steppe to the big-wave winters of Nazaré.
